Combat: knocked-out foes taken away.script: (function(){const T=storage.cbTP||{},tk=check({type:'game-tick'})||0,H=check({type:'npc-health',npc:'anySceneNPC'})||{},out=[],kept=[],re=[],GN=storage.koGone||{};const A=check({type:'action-text'}),at=String(Array.isArray(A)?(A[A.length-1]||''):(A||''));const KEEP=/\b(restrain|cuff|tie (him|her|them)|bind|question|interrogate|carry (him|her|them)|drag (him|her|them)|hold (him|her|them)|keep (him|her|them)|take (him|her|them) (with|to))/i.test(at);const VIL=/League of Villains Recruit|Independent Villain/.test(JSON.stringify(check({type:'player-traits'})||''));for(const n of Object.keys(T)){const t=T[n];if(!t||typeof t.aw!=='number'||t.aw>=tk)continue;if(typeof H[n]!=='number')continue;const b=n.replace(/ \([^)]*\)$/,'');t.aw=1e9;if(KEEP){kept.push(b);continue;}effects.push({type:'npc-placement',npc:n,operation:'moveAway'});GN[n]=tk;out.push(b);}for(const n of Object.keys(GN)){if(tk-GN[n]>4){delete GN[n];continue;}if(GN[n]<tk&&typeof H[n]==='number'){effects.push({type:'npc-placement',npc:n,operation:'moveAway'});re.push(n.replace(/ \([^)]*\)$/,''));}}storage.koGone=GN;if(!out.length&&!kept.length&&!re.length){skip=true;return;}storage.cbTP=T;const W=x=>x.join(' and ')+(x.length>1?' are':' is');if(out.length)effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only: '+W(out)+' knocked out, never dead: '+(VIL?'their own people drag them off now while the player gets clear':'police or medics take them away now')+'. They leave the scene this turn and are not described again; the fight with them is over.'});if(re.length)effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only: '+W(re)+' already gone, taken away after the knock-out: not here, not speaking, never described in this scene.'});if(kept.length)effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only: '+W(kept)+' knocked out and in the player character'+String.fromCharCode(39)+'s hands as the player asked: down for good, unable to fight, flee or use a Quirk; the fight with them is over.'});log('ko away '+out.join(', ')+(kept.length?' kept '+kept.join(', '):'')+(re.length?' again '+re.join(', '):''));})();
